title: Decorated Christmas Tree, 1958 Vintage B&W Domestic Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white vintage snapshot stamped January 1958 featuring a decorated Christmas tree placed atop a folding table inside a mid-century home interior. Bright natural light filters in from a large glass door behind the tree. Next to the tree stands a unique floor stand holding a birdcage. The scene captures post-war American holiday traditions and domestic decor of the late 1950s.
